acceptance_criteria.criterion: One deliberate width/measure system governs every reading surface (papers, prose, sections, figures); verified on all pages at 1440 and 390, both modes; documented as tokens.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Measured, fixed, then made doctrine. Before: story prose 1072px (~105-126ch) vs section prose 541-672px. Now: .bp-paper-surface > * defaults to --measure (672px), 25 figure roots opt out to the new --figure token; inert .shell/.storyShell deleted; fifth CI gate scripts/check-measure.mjs parses the doctrine from globals.css, renders the live 9-paper corpus and FAILS on any unknown wide block (proven by removing bp-duel → exit 1). Verified 1440+390, light+dark: 183 top-level blocks, 152 at measure, 31 on the figure band. House doctrine (720/640, CI-pinned 3x) compared with real glyph measurements; its STRUCTURE adopted, its pixels honestly rejected as tuned to another font.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A full visual review fleet has screenshotted and reviewed every page (both modes, both widths) against design-skill criteria; every finding filed and every accepted finding fixed; before/after archived.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: A visual review fleet screenshotted every page at 1440+390, light+dark (116 shots + 126 slices + audit.json + 260 measured contrast pairs), reviewed against frontend-design and dataviz criteria, and filed review/findings.json — 26 ranked findings (5 blocker, 11 major). All 10 headline findings closed: mobile scroll (494px→0 overflow across 104 combos), stat tiles (0 broken values, 6-up@145px→4-up@256px), blue callout removed from the palette, paper type 17→19px with hyphens:manual, duel rebuilt as a dumbbell on a shared scale, nav wrap + sub-44px tap targets, footer pinned (85px bare page→0), lineage widths, eyebrow spacing, dark footer seam. Re-measured after: 274 contrast pairs, 0 AA failures, 0 regressions. Before in review/, after in review-after/.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The block vocabulary audit is done and each story uses the types that serve it; no soul story is prose+figures only where richer canonical types genuinely help.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Audit done and acted on: the registry holds 77 types, jarl used ~12 and could not express its evidence at all. The figure family became FIRST-CLASS canonical vocabulary upstream (barkpark #8475): duel and lineage as new block types, stat gained unit/body/source, and the kilde evidence-law renders as source stamps on all five surfaces (web, email, TUI, mobile, Studio) — with Studio editing landed too. Then #8570 added a per-block poster on asciicast. Each soul story now uses the types that serve it: scaffy lineage+2 stat-grids+duel+2 casts, bulldocs columns+lineage+stat+blockquote+cast+screenshot, cloud lineage+stat+screenshot+cast, full-blast lineage+stat, spreadsheet-wizard columns+lineage+stat. Honest limits recorded: barkpark-cloud has no capturable surface, and Go TUI + mobile cannot carry a poster (documented in code, not silently skipped).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The media doctrine is written and executed: real product screenshots and at least three asciinema recordings live in stories, each capture kilde-stamped (recorded-at + version); generative figures remain where synthetic is honest.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Doctrine written and published as a paper in the system it describes: /papers/jarl-mediedoktrinen (live 200) — screenshot where the thing has a surface, asciicast where it lives in the terminal, generative drawing only where nothing can be captured honestly (and it SIGNALS absence, not decoration), plus the kilde requirement and the card-crop craft. Executed: 4 terminal recordings live (Scaffy's full round-trip receipt, bp paper view, the 4382-task board, Nextgen scaffold) placed in stories with posters pointing at the moment that proves the claim; 12 real captures across 20 projects incl. 8 live client sites re-cropped to the card band by eye; every capture carries a visible kilde caption (live URL + capture date) — ProjectImage.caption now renders under the hero (commit 4213e9b) after being stored and silently dropped.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Peak polish verified in production: every page passes the flagship bar in a final visual pass (lead-reviewed screenshots), all gates green, OG images at parity with page quality.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Final production sweep 2026-07-31: 16 surfaces checked, all 200 (home, prosjekter, om, kontakt, notater, the soul stories incl. the two new client docs, all three papers, sitemap, feed); unknown slug still a true 404; instance API 200 and Studio 302 — the platform survived every deploy. Grid verified by eye at 1440 in light AND dark with all images force-decoded (12/12 painted at 1440x586, no lazy-load mirage — an earlier pass fooled me with blank cards): terminal frames, client plates and generative drawings alternate with no card reading as empty. Five CI gates green throughout (contrast 274 pairs 0 AA failures, tokens, hover, sources 88 data, measure). OG images regenerate per project from the same content.

documents.close_reason: Epic 9 complete. jarl.no went from a correct engineer's site to a flagship. WIDTH: one measure doctrine (prose 672 / figure 1072) with both widths tokenised, the rule inverted so new engine blocks are correct by default, inert wrappers deleted, and a fifth CI gate that fails the build if any block ever goes wide again. REVIEW: a design-skill review fleet shot every page at both widths in both modes, filed 26 ranked findings, and all ten headline defects are closed — mobile scroll 494px→0, stat tiles no longer break their own numbers, the foreign blue callout gone, paper type 17→19px without auto-hyphens, the duel rebuilt as a dumbbell on a shared scale, nav and tap targets, footer pinned. VOCABULARY: duel, lineage and the kilde evidence-law became first-class canonical PortableDoc types upstream (#8475) on all five render surfaces with Studio editing, and asciicast gained a per-block poster (#8570). MEDIA: the doctrine is written and published in the system it describes (/papers/jarl-mediedoktrinen) and executed — 4 terminal recordings showing the tools actually working, 12 real captures across 20 projects including 8 live client sites re-cropped by eye to the card band, every capture carrying a visible kilde. CONTENT: all soul stories now open with what the thing offers, 22-34% shorter, commit archaeology out of the prose and into sourced figures. Contrast held at 274 pairs, 0 AA failures, 0 regressions throughout. The 8 remaining generative cards are honest: no capturable surface exists for them.
documents.description: Owner's wish verbatim: «Vi trenger mye høyere kvalitet - og tilpass standard bredde som vi bruker etc - kjør visuelle gjennomganger - vi trenger å bruke design skills - vi må fikse alle prosjektene til peak kvalitet - alle portable docs på Jarl.no skal være ypperste kvalitet - samt vi må legge planer for bruk av bilder, asciterm videoer - og lignende - dette skal være peak aesthetics og utnyttelse av Barkpark Portable Docs Bulldocs systemet - det må være vakkert - flagship.» STATE: 18 project pages + 3 papers live; 6 soul stories are Bulldocs papers rendered by the canonical engine; figure family (stat/duel/lineage+kilde) canonical on 5 surfaces; the registry holds 77 block types of which jarl uses ~12. KNOWN GAPS: content-column width inconsistency between .bp-paper-surface, Prose and section bands (owner flagged 'standard bredde'); figures render correctly but not yet BEAUTIFULLY (spacing, rhythm, scale at 390px unverified per page); zero images and zero asciicasts in any story — yet hydratePortableDoc ALREADY plays asciicast and mermaid natively, and the media plugin + generative artwork module exist. MOVEMENTS: (1) width system — one deliberate measure scale for every reading surface, verified across all 21 pages both modes; (2) visual review fleet — screenshot every page at 1440+390 in light+dark, review with design-skill criteria (frontend-design + dataviz skills mandated for builders), file and fix every finding; (3) block-vocabulary exploitation — audit the 77 types, use what serves each story (columns, blockquote, expandable, code, chart...), never decoration for its own sake; (4) media plan + execution — real screenshots where products have UIs (Studio, Galleryspace, SVGLoop, Full Blast), asciinema recordings for terminal souls (Scaffy runs, bp CLI, Doey tmux grid), generative figures elsewhere; a written media doctrine (what deserves which medium, kilde law applies to captures too: recorded-at + version); (5) peak polish — typography rhythm, figure scale, mobile excellence, OG parity. Definition of beautiful: a stranger screenshots a page because it looks that good.
documents.design: REFINED DIRECTION (owner, verbatim, 2026-07-31 — THE BAR for every builder): «mye mer menneskelig og spennende vinkling - enklere - kortere - mer bilder - grafer - videoer fra terminalen - screenshots av app o.l. - mindre oppsummering av commits og slik - større fokus på hva tjenestene tilbyr og hvordan det kan utiliseres - hvis noe er vanskelig å forstå, så er det ikke godt nok.» Consequences: commit counts and repo-history recitation LEAVE the prose (numbers live in figures with kilde, not in sentences); every story answers 'hva tilbyr dette meg, og hvordan bruker jeg det' before anything else; SHORTER — cut, cut, cut; media-first: a terminal video or product screenshot beats three paragraphs. The comprehension test is absolute: difficult to understand = not good enough.
documents.disposition_reason: ADJUDICATED 2026-08-20 by the board-reconciliation audit. NOT REOPENED, and the close attribution is untouched. VERDICT: this epic was closed OVER its own wave, but the falsity is SCOPE, not fabrication. WHAT IS TRUE, verified independently against the live site and the tree, not against the stamps: 4 asciicasts live, 52 images across 29 routes, the media doctrine paper live with all 8 mandated sections, and scripts/check-measure.mjs a real blocking CI gate on jarl-website. The prior waves' output is real and this row deserves credit for it. WHAT IS FALSE: the close swallowed the flagship wave's 18 slices whole. Chronology, all timestamps read back from the ledger and GitHub: parent created 13:17:34Z; all 18 children created 15:43-16:18Z; parent stamped done at 18:18:34Z with every one of the 18 still OPEN; PR #8525, carrying THIS EPIC'S OWN wave-1 charter, merged at 19:50:36Z. The epic was closed 92 minutes BEFORE its own charter landed. THREE CORROBORATIONS. (1) The close_reason above cites /papers/jarl-mediedoktrinen, which returns HTTP 404; the live paper is /papers/jarl-media-doctrine, HTTP 200. (2) Criterion 3's evidence asserts a 77-type registry, a figure this epic's own charter D11 corrects and explicitly says not to resurrect. (3) Parent and child assert MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE designs, both stamped true: the parent says .shell/.storyShell were DELETED, child jf-w1-width-tokens-gate-rig criterion 1 says they BIND --measure-figure. jarl-website main agrees with the parent, so the CHILD's stamp is the false one. CONSEQUENCE: this done row does NOT mean the flagship wave is finished. Of its 18 children, 2 are built, 15 are real unbuilt work and 1 is unverifiable by design. All six children that carried an unmeetable 'PR merged (merge-gated)' criterion were corrected on this same date: no PR was ever opened for any of them, jarl-website has had exactly ONE pull request ever, and the remedy for that work is BUILD IT, never wait for a merge. The two false child stamps are tracked separately as task-0e7a1a8ed32b5de5 and are not adjudicated here. Priority-0 child jf-backlog-rotate-admin-tokens is a standing credential exposure and is escalated separately.
